body.name: Measured source slice \(\operatorname{Slice}(S,\ell)\)
body.construction: For a legal \(S\) with oracle reply \((h_S,\operatorname{supp}_S)\) and a consistent \(|\mathrm{LIT}|\)-bit label \(\ell\), \(\operatorname{Slice}(S,\ell)\) is the symbolic READ projection of \(h_S\) conditioned on \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\). It is defined exactly when the returned support table gives that event positive mass. Extraction returns no source factor unless every counterfactual ancestor required by its ancestral-set transformation is READ by \(S\) or fixed by a recorded action in \(S\).
